definitions: A type of cybercrime where a perpetrator disguises themselves as a trustworthy entity in an electronic communication to trick individuals into revealing sensitive information.
An attempt to obtain sensitive information such as usernames, passwords, and credit card details (and sometimes, money) by masquerading as a trustworthy entity in an electronic communication.
examples: She almost fell victim to a sophisticated phishing attack.
The company implemented new security measures to prevent phishing attacks.
Always be wary of emails requesting personal information, as it could be a phishing attack.
